statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return the sum over i of xs[i] * ys[i], taken modulo m (xs and ys have the same length, m is positive). It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `dot_mod([3, 25, 33, 38, 24], [4, 20, 29, 17, 17], 188)`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix dot_mod
